stories.title: “I Will Go and Do” — The Brass Plates
stories.blurb: Three attempts, lost riches, an angel between brothers, and a night walk into Jerusalem 'not knowing beforehand.'

stories.title: Lehi's Dream — The Tree of Life
stories.blurb: The tree, the rod, the river, the mists, and the great and spacious building: the vision that frames the whole book.

stories.title: Nephi Sees the Condescension of God
stories.blurb: Desiring to see what his father saw, Nephi is carried to a high mountain and shown the Virgin, the Lamb, and the history of nations.

stories.title: The Broken Bow & the Liahona
stories.blurb: Fine steel breaks, families hunger, even Lehi murmurs — and a wooden bow plus a question to father reorients everyone.

stories.title: Building the Ship & Crossing the Sea
stories.blurb: 'If God had commanded me to do all things, I could do them.' Ore, bellows, a mocking audience, and a storm that humbles a ship's crew.

stories.title: The Psalm of Nephi
stories.blurb: 'O wretched man that I am!' — the record keeper's private poetry of grief, grace, and resolve.

stories.title: Lehi on Opposition in All Things
stories.blurb: Freedom, the fall, and the fruit: 'Adam fell that men might be; and men are, that they might have joy.'

stories.title: Jacob on the Infinite Atonement
stories.blurb: O the wisdom of God! Jacob's two-day temple discourse walks through death, hell, resurrection, and the plan of the great Creator.

stories.title: Nephi on the Doctrine of Christ
stories.blurb: Baptism, the Holy Ghost, enduring to the end — 'this is the way; and there is none other way.'

stories.title: The Allegory of the Olive Tree
stories.blurb: Zenos's vineyard: Israel scattered, grafted, nourished, and gathered — with the Lord of the vineyard weeping in the middle of it.

stories.title: Jacob & Sherem
stories.blurb: The first anti-Christ demands a sign — and Jacob, unshakable from his visions, lets God answer.

stories.title: Enos's Wrestle Before God
stories.blurb: A hunter kneels at dawn and rises after dark — forgiven, then praying for his people, then for his enemies.

stories.title: King Benjamin's Farewell Address
stories.blurb: From a tower over a tent city: service, the natural man, the atoning blood, and a people born again with one heart.

stories.title: Abinadi Before King Noah
stories.blurb: One man in chains against a court of priests — his face shining like Moses's — testifies of Christ until the fire takes him.

stories.title: The Covenant at the Waters of Mormon
stories.blurb: 'To mourn with those that mourn... and comfort those that stand in need of comfort' — the baptismal covenant, defined in a forest.

stories.title: Deliverance from Bondage
stories.blurb: Limhi's people escape past drunken guards; Alma's people have their burdens made light before the Lord opens the way.

stories.title: The Conversion of Alma the Younger
stories.blurb: An angel with a voice of thunder, three days as if dead, and a soul 'snatched' — the record's template of rebirth.

stories.title: Alma 5 — The Mighty Change of Heart
stories.blurb: Over forty questions to the church: Have ye received his image in your countenances? Can ye feel so now?

stories.title: Alma & Amulek in Ammonihah
stories.blurb: Two witnesses, a cunning lawyer, martyrs in the fire, and prison walls that split at the cry of faith.

stories.title: Ammon Defends the King's Flocks
stories.blurb: A prince turned servant scatters the raiders at Sebus — and his faithfulness in small things converts a kingdom.

stories.title: Abish & the Fallen Court
stories.blurb: The believing servant runs house to house; when the crowd contends, she raises the queen by the hand.

stories.title: “I Will Give Away All My Sins”
stories.blurb: The old high king, sword drawn, becomes the record's plainest voice of surrender: all my sins, to know thee.

stories.title: The People Who Buried Their Swords
stories.blurb: Rather than risk their souls, the Anti-Nephi-Lehies bury every weapon — and their deaths convert more than their swords ever could.

stories.title: Korihor the Anti-Christ
stories.blurb: 'All things denote there is a God.' The case against unbelief, argued with a sign-seeker's own script.

stories.title: The Seed of Faith (Alma 32)
stories.blurb: Cast out of their own synagogues, the humble Zoramites get the record's gentlest sermon: plant the word, and taste.

stories.title: Alma Counsels His Sons
stories.blurb: Born of God (36), the Liahona likened (37), steady Shiblon (38), and Corianton on justice, mercy, and resurrection (39–42).

stories.title: Captain Moroni & the Title of Liberty
stories.blurb: A rent coat becomes a national covenant: in memory of our God, our religion, and freedom, and our peace, our wives, and our children.

stories.title: Helaman's 2,060 Stripling Sons
stories.blurb: Too young to have taken the covenant, old enough to keep their mothers' faith — every one wounded, not one lost.

stories.title: Moroni's Angry Letter, Pahoran's Soft Answer
stories.blurb: A wartime misunderstanding and the gentlest rebuke never given: 'it mattereth not... let us resist evil.'

stories.title: Teancum's Javelin
stories.blurb: Twice into the enemy camp by night; the second time costs him everything — and ends the war.

stories.title: Nephi Receives the Sealing Power
stories.blurb: A murder revealed from a garden tower, a nation unconvinced, and a voice: 'all things shall be done unto thee according to thy word.'

stories.title: Nephi & Lehi Encircled by Fire
stories.blurb: In a Lamanite prison, a pillar of fire, a voice of perfect mildness, and three hundred converted witnesses.

stories.title: Samuel the Lamanite on the Wall
stories.blurb: Five years to the sign: a day, a night, and a day with no darkness — and the arrows cannot touch him.

stories.title: The Night Without Darkness
stories.blurb: The believers face execution at sunrise if the sign fails. Nephi prays all day — and the voice answers: 'on the morrow come I into the world.'

stories.title: Destruction, Darkness & the Voice
stories.blurb: Cities burn, sink, and are buried; three days of felt darkness — then Christ's voice, offering to gather 'as a hen gathereth her chickens.'

stories.title: The Risen Christ at the Temple
stories.blurb: One by one, 2,500 people feel the wounds. The Sermon at the Temple, the healing of every sick one, and children encircled by fire.

stories.title: The Three Who Tarried
stories.blurb: 'Ye have desired the thing which John, my beloved, desired' — three disciples who never taste death, ministering still.

stories.title: Two Hundred Years of Zion
stories.blurb: All things common, no contention, no '-ites' — the happiest people ever created by the hand of God, and how it unraveled.

stories.title: Mormon: A Sober Child in a Doomed Age
stories.blurb: Handed a nation's records at ten and its armies at sixteen, Mormon loves a people who refuse to be loved back to God.

stories.title: The Last Battle at Cumorah
stories.blurb: 'O ye fair ones' — Mormon's lament over 230,000 fallen, and the records hidden in the hill.

stories.title: The Brother of Jared Sees the Lord
stories.blurb: Sixteen molten stones, a question God answers with His finger, and a faith that cannot be kept from within the veil.

stories.title: Barges Tight Like a Dish
stories.blurb: How do we breathe? How do we steer? How do we see? — engineering by revelation, and 344 days of wind and song.

stories.title: The Jaredite Extinction
stories.blurb: Two kings who would not repent, a people drunk on vengeance, and the war that left one survivor and a prophet-witness.

stories.title: Grace: Weak Things Made Strong
stories.blurb: Moroni frets that Gentiles will mock their writing — and receives the promise every imperfect disciple leans on (Ether 12:27).

stories.title: Mormon on Faith, Hope & Charity
stories.blurb: 'Charity is the pure love of Christ, and it endureth forever' — Mormon's sermon preserved by his son.

stories.title: Moroni's Promise
stories.blurb: The record's closing challenge: ask God, with real intent, and 'he will manifest the truth of it unto you, by the power of the Holy Ghost.'
